subject: Re: Helix Health — private deployment demo & procurement pre-check
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@helixhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@helixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request: private deployment for Helix Health — compliance + networking questions

Hi Sean,

I completed the self-serve sign-up and requested a private deployment demo via the form. We are evaluating Redwood for a controlled VPC/on-prem integration with strict logging and retention requirements (SOC2 + healthcare data flow).

High level:
- Use case: secure inference for PHI-enriched documents (internal triage).
- Constraints: VPC peering preferred, no public egress for inference traffic, KMS/HSM for key management.
- Timeline: headcount & procurement window makes us target a POC in Q1.

Can we schedule a 45–60 minute demo next week that covers: architecture options (VPC vs on-prem bundle), security/compliance checklist, and a rough procurement timeline? Please include someone who can speak to network prerequisites. I attached a basic network sketch (exported from our infra team) and our SOW template for procurement.

Attaching: helix-network-sketch.png (image/png) — schematic only.

My procurement lead (cc'd on follow-up) is Rajiv Menon (r.menon@helixhealth.com), and security can be reached at security@helixhealth.com.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Cloud Security
Helix Health Systems
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, security@helixhealth.com
Date: Fri, 12 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: private deployment for Helix Health — compliance + networking questions

Hi Samantha — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the clear summary and the network sketch; helpful.

We can absolutely do a 45–60 minute session focused on the items you listed. Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-12-15 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2026-12-15 13:00–14:00
- Wed 2026-12-16 11:00–12:00

If none of those work, send two preferred windows and I’ll do my best to accommodate. I’ve cc'd Marissa (to own calendar logistics / invite) and Dev (for a technical deep-dive on networking and KMS integrations).

Agenda (draft):
1) Quick intro & goals (5m)
2) Deployment options (VPC, Private VPC, on-prem bundle) and trade-offs (15–20m)
3) Network/preflight checklist (10m) — Dev
4) Compliance guardrails & audit/logging options (10m)
5) Procurement & next steps (10m)

We can also run a short preliminary questionnaire (3–5 items) to surface any hostnames, proxy patterns, or egress constraints beforehand — would you like that?

I’ll leave scheduling and calendar details to Marissa. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise SDR
Redwood Inference
